title: Proper source direct image on vanishing topoi
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian, let $X\xrightarrow{h}Y\xrightarrow{g}S$ be morphisms of finite presentation with $h$ proper, and put $f=gh$. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring killed by an integer invertible on $S$. Write $\bar h:V_f\to V_g$ for the morphism of [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles] induced by $(h,1_S)$, with constant $\Lambda$ coefficients and constructibility as in [def-trf-oriented-constructible-sheaf]. If $L\in D^b(V_f,\Lambda)$ has constructible cohomology, then every $H^q(R\bar h_*L)$ is constructible on $V_g$. If $h$ is finite, $\bar h_*$ is exact, and a sheaf $F$ on $V_f$ is constructible if and only if $\bar h_*F$ is constructible on $V_g$. In the finite case the stalk of $\bar h_*F$ at a geometric oriented point $(y,t\to g(y))$ is the finite product of the stalks of $F$ at the points $(x,t\to f(x))$ above it, with geometric $x\in X_y$.

source.place: Sections 9.1.1-9.1.2, printed pp. 19-21; finite detection follows there from the stalk formula and Lemma 8.3.3.
